description: Finds PadelTrue catalogue documents by literal brand, model, year or shape keywords. Every keyword must match. Returns document IDs, titles and canonical product URLs for retrieval with fetch. Budget and playing-characteristic filters are available in search_rackets. Empty results describe this catalogue query, not the entire market.

query.description: Brand, model, exact year or shape keywords. Exclude conversational filler and budget/style constraints. Example: nox at10 18k 2026.
